svg.aria-label: A worksheet. Two blank timelines from 0 to 45 seconds with an upper lane and a lower lane, and three plan sentences with blank lines: my upper melody is, in version one the lower voice, in version two the lower voice.
svg.title: Plan your miniature: two blank timelines

g.text: Version one: the lower voice holds
Version two: the lower voice changes
In version one, the lower voice
In version two, the lower voice
Use note names. This sheet is for you; it is not submitted anywhere.
How to read this graphic: Each blank timeline runs from 0 to 45 seconds with a tick
every 5. The upper lane is for your melody and the lower lane is for the line beneath.
Draw bars for notes and leave gaps for rests, writing note names inside. Then complete
the three sentences at the bottom. Nothing is scored or sent anywhere.
